headline: Cupid MD Aditya Halwasiya buys 5.10 crore shares in PC Jeweller for Rs 73.59 crore
hook: Cupid chief backs PC Jeweller after rally
summary: Cupid Chairman and MD Aditya Kumar Halwasiya acquired 5.10 crore shares of PC Jeweller through a bulk deal worth approximately Rs 73.59 crore. The investment follows PC Jeweller achieving a debt-free status and coincides with a 12.59% surge in its share price. PC Jeweller shares have rallied 70% over the past six months. Indian retail investors tracking jewellery stocks and promoter-led investments should note this high-profile stake purchase following the company's balance sheet turnaround.
why_it_matters: Promoter buying signals confidence after debt reduction.
winners_losers: PC Jeweller shareholders gain / debt lenders paid
